results.title: Unconditonal
results.overview: What would you do for your cat?

results.title: Skin Writing
results.overview: Particles accumulate under the skin, causing itching and hives that follow the unsuspected lines of unnoticed scratches, minor scrapes, or bumps. Skin writing is an attempt to understand these glyphs that rush to the surface of the skin to project something onto my skin, from the inside out.

results.title: The Audition
results.overview: An aspiring actor goes to an audition where his true talents will be put to the test.

results.title: Nachtschwarm
results.overview: When Deliah, who recently lost her brother, takes a shortcut through the woods with her closest friends on the way home after graduation, an argument breaks out, and she is left alone in the woods with her brother's camera—or so she believes. The only evidence she has left are the recordings on her camera.

results.title: Resonance
results.overview: A hermit lives in voluntary exile from civilisation, attuned to the ebbs and flows of nature. In the sleepy town beneath his cabin, a young, ambitious policeman is being groomed to uphold the status quo after the retirement of his corrupt chief. When a shady local strongman's plans to legitimise his grip on the town are obstructed by the hermit's defence of the natural environment, the conflict between the two slowly simmers to a boil beneath the howl of the malfunctioning sirens of the town's Early Warning System.

results.title: How to Survive the Summer Holidays
results.overview: At a Kashubian campsite, surrounded by a lake and a forest, where families, couples, and singles come searching for a holiday break, new relationships form and conflicts escalate. Some fall in love, whilst others begin to resent each other. While the adults struggle to communicate, the children, left to their own devices, construct a world of their own, fuelled by Kashubian legends and scary stories. When, one morning, holidaymakers discover punctured tyres on their cars, the atmosphere thickens and mutual animosities come to the fore.

results.title: This Bright Light
results.overview: Tamarin Luchessa seemed destined to burn brightly. An Olympic-bound rhythmic gymnast, her course was derailed by a diabetes diagnosis as a teenager. Her life became marked by medical crises, personal struggles, and eventually a kidney and pancreas transplant that altered her personality in ways even her family and friends could not recognize—only for her original self to return when the organs later began to fail.

results.title: Cement
results.overview: A nightclub owner struggles to balance her work life with her romantic life over the course of one chaotic evening, and is ultimately forced to choose between past and present love.

results.title: The Truth Rejects You, Cornelius
results.overview: A mixed-technique animated short film about a downtrodden dog attempting to explain his toxic relationship with Avalutsa the frog to his psychologist, a talking lobster.

results.title: Smart Love
results.overview: The end and the beginning of the relationship between Jade and Caio, the first human couple in history to be brought together by an artificial intelligence.

results.title: The Shimmering Shadows
results.overview: In the heart of the Haute-Gatineau forest at the height of hunting season, humans and animals cross paths and search for each other.

results.title: Gummy
results.overview: A serial killer goes out one night in search of a new victim and ends up encountering his worst nightmare.

results.title: The Father's House
results.overview: After her father’s death, Alessandra discovers that she has inherited a share of a rural property. Never having been acknowledged by him, she agrees to meet Cora, his legitimate daughter. Their encounter unsettles the images they have each constructed of the other.

results.title: Tomato Pasta Recipe
results.overview: A day remembered differently by Seong-eun and Min-hyung, a couple on the verge of breaking up, unfold in three acts to bright, lively music. One day, they decide to make pasta together one last time before breaking up, and as tomatoes get mixed together with goldfish, Seong-eun and Min-hyeong’s memories begin to diverge.

results.title: An Uninvited Neighbor
results.overview: Cho, a Korean immigrant in Paris, lives in a studio apartment that is suddenly invaded by Gregory, a pigeon born in Paris, who in sists on living with her. A heated argument unfolds about residency, permits, birth, and rights, and neither of them backs down. Or wins.

results.title: Tale of Tails
results.overview: Teenage girls draw in a picturesque field. Loner Jimin feels that her chance has come when Minji, the popular girl everyone adores, is bitten by a venomous snake.

results.title: Amateur Energy
results.overview: Upon her return from a trip, Ha-eun declares that she is going to write poetry, while her older sister Hajeong is moved by a love letter from her boyfriend, written in English.

results.title: The Variety
results.overview: Jin-hwa, a screenwriter in her mid-thirties, still cannot escape what happened 25 years ago. In her childhood, she was slapped by her gym teacher for no reason, and she has since been plagued by tinnitus and hallucinations.
